How to play

01 / Match

Tumbling wins

Match 3 or more on a payline from the leftmost reel. Winning symbols clear and new symbols drop in.

2×4×8×
02 / Charge

Cell multipliers

A winning cell charges to 2×. Hit it again to double its value, up to 128×. The charge stays in the cell as symbols fall.

03 / Swarm

Free spins

Land 3, 4 or 5 FS for Worker Shift, Swarm Protocol or Queen Override. In Super and Hidden, bank Wilds for the final spin.
